dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...From here, we can see all of Nazuchi Beach. There are several pirate hideouts... The shipwreck in the distance is very suspicious. It's an ideal place for harboring stolen goods, deserters, bandits, robbers, or for setting up an ambush..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I sent Suzuno to inspect it but nothing was found. It seems that someone used to live in this shipwreck... The pirates are wandering around like a pack of wild hounds. This is no place to tarry..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "Next, we will make our way southwestward. Soon, we'll camp in sight of the Serpent's Head... If we encounter any deserters, we shall execute them right away..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...My nose has been bleeding since noon and I'm feeling dizzy and weak. What an insult to the reputation of the Kujou Samurai..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Kanemoto reported that he saw a kid on the island... Perhaps we should capture him and have him show us the way..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I had a nightmare. In that dream, the small island in the western sea was submerged by quicksand. That is an evil sign..."
